rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is fussy or particular.

example.english: They are very picky when buying clothes; if it is not to their liking, they will not buy it.
example.traditional: 佢買衫好揀擇，唔係啱心水就唔買。
example.jyutping: keoi5 maai5 saam1 hou2 gaan2 zaak6 m4 hai6 ngaam1 sam1 seoi2 zau6 m4 maai5

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone notices and rejects small imperfections.

example.english: You do not have to be so picky; this dish is already cooked very well.
example.traditional: 你唔好咁挑剔啦，呢碟菜已經煮得好好喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 tiu1 tik1 laa1 ne1 dip6 coi3 ji5 ging1 zyu2 dak1 hou2 hou2 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person whose demands make them difficult to satisfy or look after.

example.english: Grandma is really picky and difficult to look after at mealtimes.
example.traditional: 嫲嫲食飯有好多規矩，真係幾難服侍。
example.jyutping: maa4 maa4 sik6 faan6 jau5 hou2 do1 kwai1 geoi2 zan1 hai6 gei2 naan4 fuk6 si6
